ns2:course.label: International Organization
ns2:course.description: (POL S 371) Examines the development of basic principles underlying world organization; also considers the principles, structure, methods, and operation of international governmental institutions. Gives special attention to the United Nations and related agencies and to their evolution from the League of Nations system. Prerequisite: PS 280 or PS 283, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
